name: βk-2C-I
summary: Novel psychedelic that is the beta-ketone derivative of 2C-I.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: The drug is closely related to βk-2C-B. It is said to have a longer duration than 2C-I and to not be as intense in its effects as βk-2C-B. Concerns have been expressed about the potential toxicity of the iodine in βk-2C-I. The interactions of βk-2C-I with monoamine oxidase have been studied.

uses.text: The drug is closely related to βk-2C-B. It is said to have a longer duration than 2C-I and to not be as intense in its effects as βk-2C-B. Concerns have been expressed about the potential toxicity of the iodine in βk-2C-I. The interactions of βk-2C-I with monoamine oxidase have been studied.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Reported effects resemble those of related psychedelics: nausea, anxiety, a raised heart rate and confusion, over a long duration. Concerns have been raised about possible toxicity from its iodine.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。回報的反應與相關迷幻藥相似：噁心、焦慮、心跳加快與混亂，且持續時間很長。其碘原子可能造成的毒性曾引起擔憂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。回报的反应与相关迷幻药相似：恶心、焦虑、心跳加快与混乱，且持续时间很长。其碘原子可能造成的毒性曾引起担忧。

fact.en: It is the beta keto version of 2C-I, as bk-2C-B is of 2C-B. Its iodine atom is the heaviest thing in the molecule, and concerns have been raised about what happens when that iodine comes off.
fact.zh: 它是 2C-I 的 β 酮基版本，就如 bk-2C-B 對應 2C-B 一樣。它的碘原子是分子中最重的部分，而碘脫離後的後果曾引起擔憂。
fact.zhHans: 它是 2C-I 的 β 酮基版本，就如 bk-2C-B 对应 2C-B 一样。它的碘原子是分子中最重的部分，而碘脱离后的后果曾引起担忧。
